conclusion: The same missing parser hook is reproduced before and after the security upgrade. This is an existing Storybook/Next webpack compatibility defect.
first_cause: External webpack5.105.4 DefinePlugin.js:526:64 invokes parser.hooks.collectDestructuringAssignmentProperties.tap on the Next-bundled webpack5.98.0 parser, which has no such hook.
limitations: Baseline reuses existing installed dependencies, not a fresh npm ci. NODE_PATH only exposes the already-installed Next15.5.14 peer to its hoisted Storybook preset.
Diagnostic preload logs errors and forwards identical callbacks; it does not change module resolution or compilation logic.
The first candidate attempt inside the restricted sandbox failed at os.networkInterfaces; unrestricted local execution reproduced the actual compiler defect.
